# Run folder format

A run folder is the unit of work and the unit of sharing. It is plain files: a collaborator
can read the results without Python, and re-running any command reproduces them.

```
<run_dir>/
  recipe.json          # precious, editable
  fit_config.json      # precious, editable
  manifest.json        # disposable cache ledger
  results.csv          # generated
  results.json         # generated
  report.md            # generated
  cache/
    image/<image_hash>.npy
    background/<background_hash>.npz
    profiles/lane_NNN__<profile_hash>.json
    fits/lane_NNN__<fit_hash>.json
  render/
    *.png
    fits/lane_NNN.png
  log/
    history.jsonl        # append-only command log
```

## What each entry is for

| path | role |
|---|---|
| `recipe.json` | **precious** -- your editable intent: source image identity, lane layout, contrast, background choice. Hand-editable. |
| `fit_config.json` | **precious** -- per-lane `(profile, fit)` intent, sparse (only lanes actually fit). Deliberately NOT on the manifest, so it survives a cache wipe. Hand- and agent-editable. |
| `manifest.json` | **disposable** -- the cache ledger. Delete it and the next command rebuilds what it needs. |
| `results.csv` | generated -- one row per band, assembled from cached fits without recomputing. |
| `results.json` | generated -- the same content as the full structured result. |
| `report.md` | generated -- a human-readable markdown summary. |
| `log/history.jsonl` | append-only log of every command run against this folder. |


## Cache layout

Cache filenames carry the content hash of the inputs that produced them, so a changed
input writes a new file instead of invalidating an old one -- switching a setting back
is a cache hit, not a recompute.

| artifact | path |
|---|---|
| canonical image | `cache/image/<image_hash>.npy` |
| background-corrected image | `cache/background/<background_hash>.npz` |
| one lane's line profile | `cache/profiles/lane_000__<profile_hash>.json` |
| one lane's fit | `cache/fits/lane_000__<fit_hash>.json` |
| one lane's fit plot | `render/fits/lane_000.png` |


## Stage chain

```
  image -> background -> profile -> fit
```

Every hash is computed from the recipe and small config objects -- never from the image
pixels -- so deciding what to recompute costs a few sha256-over-small-JSON operations
regardless of image size. See [concepts](../guide/concepts.md) for what feeds each hash
and why some inputs are deliberately excluded.
